notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.9
notes.content:
Some more minor tweaks as I am trying to have the best version of Gifted: The Tombs forward for the Steam Sale :)
 - Minor UI update: B button didnt leave Library Submenu (My B - get it??)
 - A floating item bug in the "craziness" piece of the maze generation corrected
 - Beefy Mini Minotaur Rank 2 left a collision bug around when he died, this has been corrected
 - With the additional maze pieces, stores became too rare. This has been weighted slightly in our favor
 - The boss on floors 30 & 40 had default test values, almost hit for nothing with no health
 - Miniboss on floor 35 still had old stats as well, this has been corrected

!You can now buy ingots from the store, providing some end game use for gold!

Thank you for playing!

As always,
Happy Excavating

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.8: Stability and course corrections
notes.content:
Where do I start? A TON of small tasks completed in the last few days:
 - Hit/Sprint bug resolved
 - Chest initializing bug reduced (not 100% yet, will look at it!)
 - Updated/deconflicted keybinds
 - On controller, lb+rb no longer fires lb!
 - introduced a small floor start delay to permit the map to load before we run in and get unfairly pitfall'd or worse!
 - Perk descriptions can now be accurately found in the library
 - Removed (e) gems for now. They don't do what I want them to do and just kinda fill your bags :/
	This will be revisted.
 - Fixed a bug where you can vote for your group to leave the floor on accident when in the UI
	There is still a bug where only the host can pull yall out of the tombs! so be careful!
 - Spawners fire initial sound when Tombs start
	This is one of those I didnt wanna mention because it cannot be unheard lol well now it is not heard :)
 - Fixed a hadnful of mistakes in the tutorial

THREE new maze pieces have been added, one is one of the most versatile I think I could have added, these could feel very different mazes! I intend to add new maze pieces all the time so the floors stay fresh :)
Boss for floors 30 & 40 has returned from her lunch break but she still isn't feeling at 100% yet...

Issues still on my radar:
 - Making the checkpoints per account rather than per character
	This was not a change I could make hastily and will do ASAP
 - Chest initializing
	The Delay is currently so multiplayer chests can be relayed, I have made it so it doesnt happen in Solo but I want to make this cleaner
 - Client farm updates sometimes fail to save if climbing back into the tombs
	Another client side bug I was unable to reproduce but saw in a previous play through is farm updates for the client mess up. You can avoid this by returning to your own farm then rejoining the host. You dont lose anything in this process, it just appears as tho you never did any actions on the surface. This is also not a quick fix but will prioritize it with the floor checkpoint update.
 - The typo in the patch notes for 1.0.8 where I said "hadnful" instead of handful... oof. Well nothing I can do now.

New content in the works:
 - Some current enemies aren't at their fullest potential, so some new content will give them the abilities I have planned soon
 - You also aren't operating at full capacity, as stated before I intend on buff you and them with new ways to take them on. That is in the works too!

As always, feedback here on the Steam Community Hub or at our website overturnstudios.com is GREATLY appreciated :)

Happy Excavating!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6
notes.content:
[p]A lengthy multiplayer playtest revealed some NASTY scaling issues just before the floor 21 change up. I have done a larger rework here and some other goodies:
 - lengthy scaling rebalance
 - Dergen fire doesn't stun anymore (get out of the fire)
 - Items in chests have been improved and easier to unlock (A key or two now oughtta do it)
 - Removed Skele mages in the floors 20-40, you have plenty to worry about
 - Added descriptions of the passives your character unlocks to the library, but currently they aren't displaying correctly... The balance rework is important enough to get out I will have to address this in the next small patch.
 - Nothing is ever free, everything sells for at least 1g, the item details plate now shows this
 - Also moved the critical hit UI to the center of the screen. Good idea? Who knows! I feel like this is something I should allow the player to place where the want it, feedback is ALWAYS appreciated.[/p][p]
Next priorities:
 - Some key binds have changed overtime and now some are double booked
 - Been a hot minute since the floor algorithm got some upgrades...
 - Making floor checkpoints set to the account, rather than the character.
 - Will make floors 30&40 bosses not broken soon!
 - Floors 16 and 36 (if chosen as starting point) have a delayed pitfall spawn. These floors aren't the only floors with the bug, but they are the most prevalent. Be careful and let the maze algorithm do its thing until I fix plz
 - The chest on the surface needs a few seconds to initialize, I don't have a clean way to help with that right now. Take a sec and then try to interact with it again.

Should something be higher priority on my list? Let me know! :)[/p]

notes.title: Build 0.2.4: Season 1 Starts June 20th!
notes.content:
After a lengthy hiatus and lots of work on an announced project, Gifted Season 1 can begin later this month. Reminder: all of seasons 1 and 2 are included in the base purchase of the game, with no plans for a battle pass any time soon. ('Seasons' only serve to reset leaderboards, reward winners, and start fresh with new content)

Lots of goodies in the pre-season 1 patch, plenty of time to still get your Season 0 goodies :)

Ongoing plans for Season 1, mid season 1 update, and season two will always be announced on our website, overturnstudios.com. Feel free to send some feedback there, or here on the Steam Community pages!

Major changes:
- UI overhaul to improve controller support and remove bad workarounds
- Added Golem miniboss (some Season 1 content to give a taste)

Bug fixes!
 - Multiplayer inventories are safe... if you live. (this was a HUGE problem in most of season 0)
 - Tweaks to stat scaling
 - Settings were not correctly saving every time
 - Tutorial inventory now carries over to your first run

One ongoing issue still: multiplayer clients returning from a successful run actually accelerate farm reduction time. I am looking into it but somehow I think y'all will manage fine with this bug :)

Happy Excavating!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.56 - Small Follow-on Patch From 1.55
notes.content:
Hover overs were missing from buttons on the new UIs for controller menus Anvil and Forge
HUD icons for found abilities were missing on the start of the run - this has been corrected
Multiplayer scoreboard has been corrected!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.55: The Forge Update
notes.content:
New Content:
 - Forge added!	
 	You can now make level 1 armor and upgrade armor from the forge using iron ingots
 	You can smelt iron ore to iron ingots and craft iron ingots to iron keys (to be used later)
 - Sounds!
   Some pretty noticeable sounds were not included at launch... They are now included.

Bug fixes:
 - Optimization & Stability updates: Some data was incorrectly referenced which lead to some 'fatal error' crashes.
 - Fixed an issue where client players were not getting healed when levelling up
 - Fixed an issue where more than 4 players could join a game
 - Game data files will go through a conversion on install of 1.55. If you have any issues, reach out at overturnstudios.com or the Steam discussion pages.

Thank you for the patience and the interest in Gifted! Will continue to improve things as the season continues.

Happy excavating!
